steps.title: Check the notification
steps.detail: Open the source link on the scheme card and confirm the current eligibility and deadline before applying.

tips: Carry originals plus one photocopy set of every document.
common_rejections: Name mismatch between Aadhaar and the supporting document.
Unstamped or unverified form.
Income certificate older than one year.

steps.title: Create your login
steps.detail: Register on https://pmkisan.gov.in with a mobile number linked to your Aadhaar. The OTP arrives on that number.

steps.title: Fill the application
steps.detail: Enter your details exactly as they appear on your Aadhaar. A mismatch in the name or date of birth is the single most common cause of rejection.

steps.title: Upload documents
steps.detail: Scan or photograph each document. Most portals accept JPG or PDF under 200 KB per file. Required here: Aadhaar card, 7/12 land extract, Bank passbook (first page).

steps.title: Submit and note the reference
steps.detail: After submitting you get an application ID. Photograph that screen — you need the ID to track the status or to follow up at the office.

steps.title: Track it
steps.detail: Check the status on the same portal after 15 days. If it is still 'under scrutiny' after 30 days, visit the office named below with your application ID.

tips: Your name on the 7/12 extract and on Aadhaar must match exactly.
Complete e-KYC on the portal or no instalment is released.
Land must be in your own name — ancestral land still in a parent's name does not qualify.
common_rejections: Name or date of birth mismatch against Aadhaar.
Income certificate issued more than a year ago.
Bank account not seeded with Aadhaar.

steps.title: Collect the form
steps.detail: Ask for the PM Awas Yojana — Gramin application form at Gram Panchayat / Block Development Office. It is free — never pay for the form itself.

steps.title: Attach your documents
steps.detail: Attach self-attested photocopies of: Aadhaar card, Bank passbook (first page), MGNREGA job card. Carry the originals for verification.

steps.title: Get it verified
steps.detail: The Gram Sevak, Talathi or ward officer signs and stamps the form. This is the step people skip, and an unstamped form is returned.

steps.title: Submit and take a receipt
steps.detail: Hand it in at the counter and insist on a dated acknowledgement receipt. Without it you have no proof you applied.

steps.title: Follow up
steps.detail: Return with your receipt after 30 days. If there is no movement, escalate to the Block Development Officer or use the state grievance portal.
